module.title: Pharmacy Inventory, Supply and Dispensing
module.business_purpose: Prevents overselling and untraceable adjustments under concurrent manual, API, dispensing and receiving operations. The immutable ledger is the source of truth; stock positions are transactional projections optimized for reads.
